title: Sir Brian Mock Training Reviewer
purpose: Separate practice bank for Sir Brian Review Center mock-exam analysis and targeted retraining. Future questions derived from the user's submitted mock summaries belong here, not in the High-Yield 2026 bank.
disclaimer: Sir Brian Review Center mock results are used to diagnose the user's weak concepts and create original retraining questions. Exact proprietary mock questions are not republished in this public app. The High-Yield 2026 Reviewer remains a separate independent bank.

strategy.note: Mock-derived retraining is separated from the independent High-Yield 2026 bank. Missed concepts receive the highest repetition weight; correct concepts remain in rotation. Exact mock wording is not republished.
